Agomoni ’26

As the autumn breeze fills the air and the sound of the dhaak echoes once again,
the festive spirit of Durga Puja brings us together.

With hearts full of joy and memories waiting to be made,
we warmly invite you to be a part of Agomoni ’26 —
an evening of culture, celebration, music, laughter, and togetherness.

Come, let us welcome Maa Durga with open hearts,
celebrate our beautiful Bengali heritage,
and create moments that stay with us long after the festivities are over.

Your presence will make our celebration truly complete.
